supersedes: photometry-method-protocol-v2.json; preserves the frozen blend experiment and adds a full-cohort control for the 61 recovered positions.

edge_recovered_cohort.selection: Every DAO detection whose 11x11 stamp would have crossed the 256x256 cutout boundary under the pre-edge implementation: x0=floor(x-5), y0=floor(y-5), and x0<0 or y0<0 or x0+11>256 or y0+11>256.
edge_recovered_cohort.remaining_failure_cohort: Retain all detections whose current fit fails; report positions, masks, coverage and reason. Do not impute a flux or silently replace a failure.
edge_recovered_cohort.injector: Use the next pinned exposure's nearest ePSF zone at the same WCS sky location, evaluated at the science-frame subpixel position; unit-sum finite stamp, no crop renormalization.
edge_recovered_cohort.amplitude: 10 times current fitted-exposure conditional flux uncertainty derived from the registered variance and fit design; both injected and un-injected real image controls use independent diagonal-variance Gaussian perturbations.
methods: Current SIEVE fixed-position finite-ePSF plus constant local sky fit.
SIEVE one-source joint weighted fit with shared local planar background.
reported_metrics: per-position median signed and absolute fractional injected-increment error
per-position noise-replicate scatter and standardized residual coverage
all fit failures and PSF-information coverage
paired summaries by cutout edge distance and ePSF fitting/injection zone identity
limits: The exact real-scene source flux remains unknown; paired on/off differences isolate injected increments only.
A cross-exposure ePSF is a release-independent template for the fitted exposure but is not independent instrument calibration.
Noise perturbations assume diagonal archive variance and omit source shot noise and detector covariance.
This tests conditional flux response at the 61 locations; it does not validate source identity or absolute real-scene flux.
